name: Definer
rootCause: On December 13, the DeFi platform Definer oracle was attacked. This incident was caused by the problem of Definer’s implementation of the oracle in OEC. It used the token balance of a single liquidity pool at a point in time as the price source, which led to the accident. The implementation of Ethereum used ChainLink’s The oracle does not have this problem.
